arifszn-slide-wright-root.description: Create beautiful web presentations from a topic, rough notes, or an outline, and edit decks afterward — adding, removing, or revising slides. Asks how many design directions to preview and whether to animate, shows a two-slide preview of each custom theme, then builds the full deck only once the user picks a direction; edits to an existing deck skip that flow and apply in place. Use when the user wants to make slides, a presentation, a talk deck, a pitch deck, or to add/remove/change a slide in one that already exists.
